name: Mira
lines: Kael: I have a commitment to Vale. You need to know that before I offer you anything.
Mira: Then you have a conversation to have with her, not an answer to take from me. I won't be the quiet exception to your promise.

actions.label: You're right. I can offer friendship here, nothing concealed.

relationship_event.text: Kael disclosed his commitment to Vale and chose friendship with Mira rather than making a second promise.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: Nothing hidden between us. That makes the friendship possible.
